explanation: The water cycle involves freshwater evaporating from bodies of water and returning to Earth as precipitation over land. This water enters the ground, surface waters, and underground aquifers, eventually flowing back into the oceans. Human activities, particularly in the arid West and southern Florida, have disrupted this cycle through groundwater mining, which drains aquifers much faster than natural precipitation can replenish them.
